narrative.intro: Lawrence Livermore National Security has $3.4B in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Lawrence Livermore National Security has one award this fiscal year with an average award size of $3.4B, and obligations are down 5.4% year over year. Lawrence Livermore National Security posted obligations of $2.8B in FY21, $2.8B in FY22, $3B in FY23, $3.2B in FY24, and $3.6B in FY25 before the current-year total. The current-year totals are partial because the period covers fiscal year to date. This summary focuses on obligations rather than total contract values for the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables. Use the year-by-year obligations to compare scale across recent fiscal years and to see that FY25 was the highest full-year total listed at $3.6B while FY26 to date is $3.4B.

sections.heading: How has Lawrence Livermore National Security's federal business changed over recent years?
sections.body: Lawrence Livermore National Security's obligations rose from $2.8B in FY21 and $2.8B in FY22 to $3B in FY23, then to $3.2B in FY24 and $3.6B in FY25. Lawrence Livermore National Security has $3.4B in FY26 to date, which is down 5.4% year over year compared with the prior period.
